summary: Query and analyze data in Azure Data Explorer (Kusto/ADX) using KQL for log analytics, telemetry, and time series analysis. WHEN: KQL queries, Kusto database queries, Azure Data Explorer, ADX clusters, log analytics, time series data, IoT telemetry, anomaly detection.
whenToUse: Log Analytics: Application logs, system logs, audit logs
IoT Analytics: Sensor data, device telemetry, real-time monitoring
Security Analytics: SIEM data, threat detection, security event correlation
APM: Application performance metrics, user behavior, error tracking
Business Intelligence: Clickstream analysis, user analytics, operational KPIs
